BiblicalUsage: Bebai means "my cavities." He was a leader of the returning exiles. It turns up in Ezra 2:11, Ezra 8:11 and Ezra 10:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bebai matters because God remembers names the world forgets.
